svg.title: Right Riemann sums approaching the definite integral
svg.desc: Three panels show right Riemann sums for f(x) = 0.25x squared + 1 on [0, 4]: with n = 4 rectangles of width 1 the sum is 11.5, with n = 8 rectangles of width 0.5 it is 10.375, and with n = 32 rectangles of width 0.125 it is about 9.586. The rectangles hug the curve more closely each time, and the sums approach the definite integral, 28/3, about 9.333.

text.tspan: As n grows, the right sums 11.5, 10.375, 9.586 close in on the definite integral, 28/3 ≈ 9.333.
